items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: We had the rhythm section, myself on banjo, clientele was on piano, and Franz Jackson's drummer.

ctx.x: How big a band did you have?

We had about, well, Cliff King was in front of the clarinet. We had three saxophones, we had three saxophones, two altos, particularly that day, two altos and tenors. We had two trombones, we had happy on trombone, we played the trombone with his feet. And I forget his last name, isn't that a shame? And we had the rhythm section, myself on banjo, clientele was on piano, and Franz Jackson's drummer.
